name: Exp_ColorJLaguerre
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJLaguerre indicator, which is a Laguerre-filtered JMA oscillator that outputs trend states as integer values. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from state 1 to 2 and sell positions when it transitions from state 2 to 1, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management and stop-loss/take-profit are handled via the included TradeAlgorithms library.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJLaguerre指标进行交易，该指标是经拉盖尔滤波器平滑的JMA振荡器，输出整数值表示趋势状态。当指标从状态1转为2时开多仓，从状态2转为1时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。资金管理和止损止盈通过TradeAlgorithms库实现。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorJLaguerre指标，这是一种结合拉盖尔滤波器和JMA平滑的动量振荡器，输出1或2的趋势状态值。入场条件为：当指标buffer值从1变为2时产生买入信号，开多仓并可选平空仓；当指标值从2变为1时产生卖出信号，开空仓并可选平多仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈（默认1000点和2000点），以及反向信号触发的平仓机制。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，并支持多种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损保证金、亏损余额、固定手数）。策略还包含新K线检测机制以避免重复信号，并使用SignalBar参数指定信号确认的K线位置。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the ColorJLaguerre indicator, a momentum oscillator combining Laguerre filtering with JMA smoothing that outputs discrete trend states of 1 or 2. Entry conditions: when the indicator buffer transitions from 1 to 2, a buy signal is generated to open long positions and optionally close short ones; when it transitions from 2 to 1, a sell signal opens shorts and optionally closes longs. Exit conditions include stop-loss (default 1000 points) and take-profit (default 2000 points), plus optional closing on opposite signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with five money management modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss balance, and fixed lot size. The strategy includes a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals within the same bar, and uses SignalBar to specify which bar confirms the signal.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例/风险系数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损保证金/亏损余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: MM mode (free margin/balance/loss margin/loss balance/fixed lot)

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于离散趋势状态转换，信号明确无歧义
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持5种不同的仓位计算方式
新K线检测机制有效防止同根K线内重复开仓
买卖方向和开平仓均可独立开关控制，灵活性高
使用拉盖尔滤波器有效减少价格噪声，信号质量较好
pros_en: Clean and unambiguous strategy logic based on discrete trend state transitions
Flexible money management with 5 different position sizing modes
New bar detection effectively prevents duplicate entries within the same bar
Independent toggle controls for buy/sell direction and open/close operations provide high flexibility
Laguerre filtering effectively reduces price noise for better signal quality
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，可能不适合所有品种和周期
缺少点差过滤，在小周期交易时可能因点差过大导致亏损
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库和ColorJLaguerre自定义指标，缺乏独立性和可移植性
没有持仓检查，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
指标句柄创建失败时仅打印警告但不阻止EA继续运行，可能导致空指针访问
cons_en: Default SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points are excessively large and may not suit all instruments or timeframes
No spread filter, which could cause losses on smaller timeframes when spreads widen
Heavy dependency on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library and ColorJLaguerre custom indicator reduces portability
No position check before opening, potentially leading to duplicate entries in the same direction
Indicator handle creation failure only prints a warning without stopping EA execution, risking invalid handle access
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，提升实盘适应性
指标句柄创建失败时应在OnInit中返回INIT_FAILED而非继续运行
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction and prevent over-leveraging
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve live trading adaptability
Return INIT_FAILED in OnInit when indicator handle creation fails instead of continuing with invalid handle

risk_points: 指标句柄创建失败时未阻止EA运行，可能导致CopyBuffer调用失败并产生意外行为
默认止损止盈值较大，在波动性较低的品种上可能导致不必要的风险敞口
缺少持仓数量检查，可能在同方向多次开仓导致仓位过大
risk_points_en: Indicator handle creation failure does not prevent EA from running, potentially causing CopyBuffer failures and unexpected behavior
Large default SL/TP values may lead to excessive risk exposure on low-volatility instruments
No open position count check may cause over-sizing through repeated same-direction entries
